import requests, re, os, pandas as pd, matplotlib.pyplot as plt
os.makedirs("provenance",exist_ok=True)
S=requests.Session(); S.headers.update({"User-Agent":"openscientist/1.0"})
AA="ARNDCQEGHILKMFPSTWYV"
B62="""4 -1 -2 -2 0 -1 -1 0 -2 -1 -1 -1 -1 -2 -1 1 0 -3 -2 0
-1 5 0 -2 -3 1 0 -2 0 -3 -2 2 -1 -3 -2 -1 -1 -3 -2 -3

0 -2 0 -1 -3 -2 -2 6 -2 -4 -4 -2 -3 -3 -2 0 -2 -2 -3 -3
-2 0 1 -1 -3 0 0 -2 8 -3 -3 -1 -2 -1 -2 -1 -2 -2 2 -3

-2 -3 -3 -3 -2 -3 -3 -3 -1 0 0 -3 0 6 -4 -2 -2 1 3 -1
-1 -2 -2 -1 -3 -1 -1 -2 -2 -3 -3 -1 -2 -4 7 -1 -1 -4 -3 -2
1 -1 1 0 -1 0 0 0 -1 -2 -2 0 -1 -2 -1 4 1 -3 -2 -2
0 -1 0 -1 -1 -1 -1 -2 -2 -1 -1 -1 -1 -2 -1 1 5 -2 -2 0
-3 -3 -4 -4 -2 -2 -3 -2 -2 -3 -2 -3 -1 1 -4 -3 -2 11 2 -3
-2 -2 -2 -3 -2 -1 -2 -3 2 -1 -1 -2 -1 3 -3 -2 -2 2 7 -1
0 -3 -3 -3 -1 -2 -2 -3 -3 3 1 -2 1 -1 -2 -2 0 -3 -1 4"""
M=[[int(x) for x in l.split()] for l in B62.strip().split("\n")]; IDX={a:i for i,a in enumerate(AA)}
def swmap(a,b,go=-11,ge=-1):
    n,m=len(a),len(b); ia=[IDX.get(c,-1) for c in a]; ib=[IDX.get(c,-1) for c in b]
    H=[[0]*(m+1) for _ in range(n+1)];E=[[0]*(m+1) for _ in range(n+1)];F=[[0]*(m+1) for _ in range(n+1)]
    P=[[9]*(m+1) for _ in range(n+1)];best=0;bi=bj=0
    for i in range(1,n+1):
        Hi,Hi1,Ei,Fi,Fi1,Pi=H[i],H[i-1],E[i],F[i],F[i-1],P[i];x=ia[i-1];Mx=M[x] if x>=0 else None
        for j in range(1,m+1):
            e=Ei[j-1]+ge if Ei[j-1]+ge>Hi[j-1]+go else Hi[j-1]+go;Ei[j]=e
            f=Fi1[j]+ge if Fi1[j]+ge>Hi1[j]+go else Hi1[j]+go;Fi[j]=f
            y=ib[j-1];s=(Mx[y] if (Mx is not None and y>=0) else -1);d=Hi1[j-1]+s
            v=0;p=9
            if d>v:v=d;p=0
            if e>v:v=e;p=1
            if f>v:v=f;p=2
            Hi[j]=v;Pi[j]=p
            if v>best:best=v;bi,bj=i,j
    i,j=bi,bj;pairs=[]
    while i>0 and j>0 and H[i][j]>0:
        p=P[i][j]
        if p==0: pairs.append((i,j)); i-=1;j-=1
        elif p==1: j-=1
        elif p==2: i-=1
        else: break
    return best, {i:(j,b[j-1]) for i,j in pairs}
def uni(a): return S.get(f"https://rest.uniprot.org/uniprotkb/{a}.json",timeout=60).json()["sequence"]["value"]

ACC={"P05089":"Human arginase ARG1","P53608":"B. caldovelox arginase","P60651":"E. coli SpeB agmatinase",
     "Q5JI38":"T. kodakarensis APA ureohydrolase","Q8A8R8":"BT_1099 sole PF00491"}
SEQ={a:uni(a) for a in ACC}
LIG=[101,124,126,128,232,234]
direct={a:swmap(SEQ["P05089"],SEQ[a]) for a in ["P53608","P60651","Q5JI38","Q8A8R8"]}
sc_tk,mp_tk=direct["Q5JI38"]
sc_bt_tk,mp_bt_tk=swmap(SEQ["Q5JI38"],SEQ["Q8A8R8"])

rows=[]
print(f"{'ARG1':>5} {'res':>4} | {'B.cald':>7} {'SpeB':>7} {'TkAPA':>7} | {'BT_1099 direct':>14} {'BT_1099 via TkAPA':>18}")
for p in LIG:
    r=[(direct[a][1][p][1]+str(direct[a][1][p][0]) if p in direct[a][1] else "n/a") for a in ["P53608","P60651","Q5JI38"]]
    d=direct["Q8A8R8"][1]; dirn=(d[p][1]+str(d[p][0])) if p in d else "n/a"
    tv="n/a"
    if p in mp_tk:
        tk=mp_tk[p][0]
        if tk in mp_bt_tk: tv=mp_bt_tk[tk][1]+str(mp_bt_tk[tk][0])
    print(f"{p:>5} {SEQ['P05089'][p-1]:>4} | {r[0]:>7} {r[1]:>7} {r[2]:>7} | {dirn:>14} {tv:>18}")
    rows.append({"ARG1_col":p,"ARG1":SEQ['P05089'][p-1],"B_caldovelox":r[0],"Ecoli_SpeB":r[1],
                 "Tk_APA_ureohydrolase":r[2],"BT_1099_direct":dirn,"BT_1099_via_TkAPA":tv})
pd.DataFrame(rows).to_csv("provenance/bt1099_Mn_ligand_mapping.csv",index=False)

# the one column outside every alignment: ARG1 H101 == Tk H114. Inspect the corresponding BT_1099 region.
print("\n--- ARG1 H101 / Tk H114 region, inspected by eye in each sequence ---")
for a,lab in [("P05089","ARG1 95-104"),("P53608","B.cald 93-102"),("P60651","SpeB 120-129"),("Q5JI38","TkAPA 108-117")]:
    st={"P05089":95,"P53608":93,"P60651":120,"Q5JI38":108}[a]
    print(f"  {lab:18s} {SEQ[a][st-1:st+9]}")
bt=SEQ["Q8A8R8"]
print(f"  BT_1099 N-term upstream of the aligned block (res 60-100): {bt[59:100]}")
print(f"  His positions in BT_1099 1-100: {[i+1 for i,c in enumerate(bt[:100]) if c=='H']}")

accs=list(ACC)
mat=pd.DataFrame(index=accs,columns=accs,dtype=float)
for i,a in enumerate(accs):
    for b in accs[i:]:
        s,_=swmap(SEQ[a],SEQ[b]); mat.loc[a,b]=s; mat.loc[b,a]=s
print("\n=== Pairwise SW scores (BLOSUM62 -11/-1) ===")
pm=mat.copy(); pm.index=[ACC[a] for a in accs]; print(pm.astype(int).to_string())
mat.to_csv("provenance/bt1099_sw_score_matrix.csv")

PS=re.compile(r"[LIVMFY].{2}[GSTAV]G[DE]H[SGA]")
print("\n=== PROSITE PS01053 scan (sensitivity control) ===")
for a in accs:
    m=[x.group() for x in PS.finditer(SEQ[a])]
    print(f"  {ACC[a]:34s} {'HIT '+str(m) if m else 'MISS'}")

fig,ax=plt.subplots(1,2,figsize=(13,4.6))
labs=["B. caldovelox\narginase","E. coli SpeB\nagmatinase","T. kodakarensis\nAPA ureohydrolase","BT_1099\n(B. theta)"]
vals=[direct[a][0] for a in ["P53608","P60651","Q5JI38","Q8A8R8"]]
ax[0].bar(labs,vals,color=["#4c72b0","#4c72b0","#4c72b0","#c44e52"])
for i,v in enumerate(vals): ax[0].text(i,v+8,str(int(v)),ha="center",fontsize=9)
ax[0].set_ylabel("Smith-Waterman score vs human ARG1")
ax[0].set_title("BT_1099 is far diverged from every characterised ureohydrolase")
ax[0].tick_params(axis="x",labelsize=8)
cols=["B_caldovelox","Ecoli_SpeB","Tk_APA_ureohydrolase","BT_1099_via_TkAPA"]
dfm=pd.DataFrame(rows).set_index("ARG1_col")[cols]
grid=[[1 if str(dfm.loc[p,c])[0]==SEQ['P05089'][p-1] else (0.5 if str(dfm.loc[p,c])=="n/a" else 0) for c in cols] for p in LIG]
ax[1].imshow(grid,cmap="RdYlGn",vmin=0,vmax=1,aspect="auto")
ax[1].set_xticks(range(4)); ax[1].set_xticklabels(["B.cald","SpeB","TkAPA","BT_1099"],fontsize=9)
ax[1].set_yticks(range(6)); ax[1].set_yticklabels([f"{SEQ['P05089'][p-1]}{p}" for p in LIG],fontsize=9)
for i,p in enumerate(LIG):
    for j,c in enumerate(cols): ax[1].text(j,i,str(dfm.loc[p,c]),ha="center",va="center",fontsize=8)
ax[1].set_title("Mn(II) cluster ligands (ARG1 numbering)\ngreen = conserved, grey = outside alignment")
plt.tight_layout(); plt.show()
